lines.text: Many learners say: You have reason.

native.tip: En español “tienes razón”, pero en inglés no se dice “have reason”: se dice “you are right.”
native.caption: 🙈 Error común: “You have reason.” “Tener razón” se traduce con el verbo “be”: “You are right.” ¡Escucha a Ama y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.
native.comment: Respuesta: “are”. Para “tener razón” usa “be right”, nunca “have reason”. Escribe una frase tuya con “are” o dila en voz alta: {link}

en.tip: Learners say “tienes razón” with have, but English says “you are right.”
en.caption: Common mistake: “You have reason.” “Tener razón” uses “be” in English: “You are right.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
